clips.title: The story
paras: Southshore Town Hall serves as the administrative seat of the southern coast of Hillsbrad Foothills, standing as one of the last functioning centers of Lordaeron's civil authority. From inside, Magistrate Henry Maleb coordinates local defenses and governs the town's surviving populace. The hall is a vital hub for the Alliance as they struggle to maintain a foothold in the plagued north.

While much of Lordaeron lies shattered under Scourge corruption and Forsaken expansion, Southshore's town hall maintains the semblance of an intact human government. Magistrate Henry Maleb oversees daily governance from his office here, working alongside officials like Kundric Zanden to secure resources and preserve civic order. In a region surrounded by aggressive undead, Syndicate rogues, and Hillsbrad's fierce border skirmishes, the hall is the nerve center directing the town's survival against constant threats.
